items.title: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 world model
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a world model for real-time interactive simulation with greater realism and native audio. Users can steer the world and its soundscape with natural language. It is a research preview for a limited group of trusted testers, with wider access planned for Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and for early access partners in the Gemini API and AI Studio.

items.title: Google DeepMind announces Gemini 4 Carbon as its next frontier model
items.summary_en: In a post on its official X account, Google DeepMind described Gemini 4 Carbon as its next frontier model, stating it is state-of-the-art across cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities. Per the post, an initial group of cyber defenders will give feedback on guardrails before access expands soon.
items.notes: Search snippet only; post not opened. Date inferred. Performance claims are the company's own, not independently evaluated.
